        0 < s →

            (dimH A < ENNReal.ofReal s → Hmeasure s A = 0) ∧
              (ENNReal.ofReal s < dimH A → Hmeasure s A = ∞) ∧
                (Hmeasure s A = 0 → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s) ∧ (Hmeasure s A = ∞ → ENNReal.ofReal s ≤ dimH A)) →
      (Bornology.IsBounded E ∧
          (∃ B, 1 ≤ B ∧ ∀ x ∈ E, ‖x‖ ≤ B) ∧
            (∀ (s δ : ℝ),
                0 < s →
                  0 < δ →
                    ∃ k U,
                      E ⊆ ⋃ i, U i ∧
                        (∀ (i : Fin k), Metric.ediam (U i) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ) ∧ ∑ i, Metric.ediam (U i) ^ s < ∞) ∧
              ∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → Hscale s δ E < ∞) →
        (0 < n → ∀ (a : ℝ), ↑n < a → (∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → Hscale a δ E = 0) ∧ Hmeasure a E = 0) →
          Bornology.IsBounded E ∧
            (∀ (s δ : ℝ),
                0 < s →
                  0 < δ →
                    ∃ k U,
                      E ⊆ ⋃ i, U i ∧
                        (∀ (i : Fin k), Metric.ediam (U i) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ) ∧ ∑ i, Metric.ediam (U i) ^ s < ∞) ∧
              (∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → Hscale s δ E < ∞) ∧
                0 ≤ dimH E ∧ dimH E ≤ ↑n ∧ dimH E < ∞ ∧ (n = 0 → E = Set.univ ∧ dimH E = 0)
